title: Spec 022 — Dev-mode plugin install (Wave A enabler)
prompt:
Implement Spec 022 (dev-mode-install) per Plan/022-dev-mode-install/spec.md.

MANDATORY:
1. Read Plan/JULES_PROTOCOL.md FIRST. Run all four gates in order (Confidence ≥ 0.90, TDD Red-Green-Refactor, Evidence under ## Evidence in PR body, Self-Review answered).
2. Only modify paths under the spec's `affects:` allow-list:
   - .claude-plugin/plugin.json
   - .mcp.json
   - servers/agency-mcp/pyproject.toml
   - servers/agency-mcp/run.py (create)
   - servers/agency-mcp/README.md
   - docs/dev-setup.md (create)
   - bin/agency-dev-install (create, chmod +x)
   - tests/smoke/test_dev_install.py (create)
3. Branch: create a fresh `claude/022-dev-mode-install-<rand>` working branch off origin/Master.
4. PR base: Master (capitalised — NOT main). PRs targeting `main` return 422.
5. PR body MUST contain: ## Spec, ## Confidence (the 5-row weighted table), ## Evidence (one fenced code block per Done-When item), ## Self-Review (the 3 questions).
6. After auto-PR creation, VERIFY the branch exists on remote at github.com/netzkontrast/the-agency-system/branches before declaring COMPLETED. A clean `git status` is NOT proof of publication — read JULES_PROTOCOL §8 for silent-fail recovery.
7. Acceptance Gherkin scenarios 022.1 through 022.4 must each have evidence pasted in the PR body.

Reference reading (do NOT vendor-clone):
- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins
- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference
- https://gofastmcp.com/servers/transforms/code-mode
- https://docs.astral.sh/uv/pip/install/#editable-installs

If any ambiguity surfaces, open a draft PR labelled `[BLOCKED: clarification]` and stop — do not guess.
